title: From Accuracy to Robustness: A Study of Rule- and Model-based Verifiers in Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2505.22203v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Trustworthy verifiers are essential for the success of reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), which is the core methodology behind various large reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1. In complex domains like mathematical reasoning, rule-based verifiers have been widely adopted in previous works to train strong reasoning models. However, the reliability of these verifiers and their impact on the RL training process remain poorly understood. In this work, we take mathematical reasoning as a case study and conduct a comprehensive analysis of various verifiers in both static evaluation and RL training scenarios. We show that widely used rule-based verifiers fail to recognize equivalent answers in different formats, leading to substantial false negatives that increasingly hinder RL performance as the policy model gets stronger. translated_title: 从精确性到稳健性：数学推理中基于规则与基于模型的验证器研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.22203v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：可信赖的验证器对于带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的成功至关重要，这是DeepSeek-R1等各类大型推理模型背后的核心方法。在数学推理等复杂领域中，先前工作广泛采用基于规则的验证器来训练强大的推理模型。然而，这些验证器的可靠性及其对强化学习训练过程的影响仍未被充分理解。在本研究中，我们以数学推理为案例，在静态评估和强化学习训练场景下对多种验证器进行了全面分析。我们表明，广泛使用的基于规则的验证器无法识别不同格式的等价答案，导致大量假阴性结果，随着策略模型变得更强，这些问题会日益阻碍强化学习性能。基于模型的验证器显著提高了静态准确性，但极易受到重...
tldr: 本研究发现基于规则的验证器在数学推理中因无法识别等价答案而产生假阴性，阻碍强化学习性能，而基于模型的验证器虽提升静态准确性但存在稳健性问题，强调验证器需从精确性转向稳健性。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that rule-based verifiers in mathematical reasoning suffer from false negatives due to failing to recognize equivalent answers, hindering RL performance, while model-based verifiers improve static accuracy but face robustness issues, highlighting the need for verifiers to shift from accuracy to robustness.
